BrochureContent.Content:
Murphy Mullan are delighted to present No. 53 Knocklyon Road, a superb 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom semi-detached residence ideally positioned in one of Dublin 16’s most sought-after and family-friendly locations. 

This beautifully extended home offers generous living space throughout, making it perfect for growing families seeking both comfort and convenience. The property boasts a bright and well-proportioned interior, with large reception areas providing flexibility for modern family living. The extended layout enhances the sense of space, creating an inviting flow between living, dining, and kitchen areas—ideal for both everyday life and entertaining.

A standout feature of the property is its versatile layout, with two bedrooms located on the ground floor, making it ideal for family living, guest accommodation, or home office use. A full bathroom on each level adds to the home’s practicality and convenience. Upstairs, there are two further spacious bedrooms along with a second bathroom, providing a well-balanced layout for family life.

To the rear, the home truly shines with a large, private garden—perfect for children, outdoor dining, or future landscaping potential. To the side, a garage offers excellent storage or scope for conversion (subject to planning permission).

Located on Knocklyon Road, this property benefits from a wealth of local amenities including schools, parks, shops, and excellent transport links as well as Rathfarnham and Templeogue village all within easy reach. The M50 is just minutes away, making commuting a breeze.

Viewing highly recommended.

Semi-Detached 4-bedroom home with flexible layout.
2 bedrooms on ground floor.
